candidates.explanation: The stored path is built as `/${apiPrefix}/v1/${file.filename}`. It leaves out the `files` segment. The download route is `GET /v1/files/:path` (controller path `files`). The returned link is `<backendDomain>/api/v1/<name>.png`, which matches no route, so it gives 404 even though multer saved the file in ./files.

fix.description: Include the files directory in the stored path. Use `/${apiPrefix}/v1/files/${file.filename}`, or use multer's `file.path` (`files/<name>`) as upstream does: `/${apiPrefix}/v1/${file.path}`.
